field_updates.detail: p7: the high dielectric constant type (X5R type etc.) changes capacitance under DC bias while C0G hardly changes; Fig. 3 is labelled an example. p8: DC bias characteristics are measured per part from 0 Vdc to rated voltage. A part-specific measured curve is therefore required; the document states no rating. Note: per part is inferred; p8 gives measure settings keyed to each part's nominal capacitance C and rated voltage (1 kHz for C<=10 uF, 120 Hz for C>10 uF; 0.5 or 1 Vrms; 60 s bias; 25+/-3 C) and does not itself say per part.
field_updates.scope: Murata high-K X5R/X7R MLCC; inferred from the SimSurfing measurement-conditions presentation, not a part datasheet; not a universal package curve; p7 names the X5R type etc. only; X7R is named as a high dielectric constant type on p9

field_updates.detail: p2: the aging process is reversible by de-aging (heating over the Curie point, approx 125c, returns the capacitance to its value after manufacturing); after soldering the capacitors have essentially been de-aged. p1: aging is affected by time, temperature, voltage (voltage has a minute effect); no temperature or voltage is stated with the -2.5% figure.
field_updates.scope: Johanson typical X7R/X5R example; not a rated value for an unspecified Murata/TDK part; decade hours counted after manufacturing
